# Field recordings

Judge Dean LLC edited the following CC0 recordings into the lossless `field-foley.flac` sample bank. The game alternates between separately performed takes. The edits select individual contacts, remove low-frequency rumble, adjust levels, and taper clip ends.

| In-game use | Original recording | Recordist |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wide camera | [Sony A7IV Camera Shutter](https://freesound.org/people/jeiteerei/sounds/790442/) | jeiteerei |
| Telephoto camera | [Camera Shutter, Canon EOS 350D](https://freesound.org/people/aGreenGuy/sounds/723156/) | aGreenGuy |
| Grass | [Hiking Boot Footsteps on Grass](https://freesound.org/people/Fission9/sounds/521587/) | Fission9 |
| Gravel | [Hiking Boot Footsteps on Gravel](https://freesound.org/people/Fission9/sounds/521588/) | Fission9 |
| Wood | [Hiking Boot Footsteps on Wooden Planks](https://freesound.org/people/Fission9/sounds/521589/) | Fission9 |
| Stone | [Hiking Boot Footsteps on Stone](https://freesound.org/people/Fission9/sounds/521590/) | Fission9 |
| Carpet | [Footsteps on a carpet.wav](https://freesound.org/people/jop9798/sounds/142008/) | jop9798 |
| Rain on uncovered ground | [Walking through puddle](https://freesound.org/people/NachtmahrTV/sounds/553238/) | NachtmahrTV |

The recordists released these sounds under [Creative Commons CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
